title: TH17 cells contribute to uveitis and scleritis and are inhibited by IL-27/STAT1 in the retina. \(3) Western Blot Analysis
protocol: Grow cells up to 80% confluence as indicated.
Replace medium with starvation medium (1% BSA) and starve for 2 hours.
Stimulate starved cells with cytokines or growth factors as described above.
Rinse cells with ice-cold PBS after stimulation.
Add 0.6 ml of lysis buffer (with freshly added inhibitors) to a 100 mm cell culture plate on ice.
Scrape the plate with a cell scraper.
Transfer lysate using a 2 ml pipette or syringe fitted with a 21 gauge needle into a chilled microcentrifuge tube.
Wash the plate once with 0.3 ml of lysis buffer and combine with first lysate.
Pass through a 21 gauge needle to shear DNA.
Add fresh 10 μl stock PMSF (10 mg/ml) and incubate on ice for 30 minutes.
Microcentrifuge cell lysate at maximum speed in microfuge for 30 minutes at 4°C.
Collect supernatant in a fresh tube.
Centrifuge supernatant again for 10 minutes; the supernatant fluid is the total cell lysate.
Aliquot samples and freeze at -70°C.
Quantitate protein extract by photometry.
Use approximately 20-50 μg of purified protein, nuclear or whole cell extract.
Mix with 4X NuPAGE sample buffer to make a 1X solution.
Denature proteins in loading buffer with reducing reagent for 10 minutes at 70 degrees and vortex to mix.
Wash wells.
Load 10-20 μl of sample into the wells.
Run at 200 V until the first blue band is at the bottom (35-50 min).
Soak gel in transfer buffer for 15 minutes (with 3 buffer changes).
Wet membrane in 100% methanol for 15 seconds.
Wet membrane in H₂O for 2 minutes.
Wet membrane in transfer buffer for at least 5 minutes.
Wet two sheets of thick filter paper in transfer buffer.
Place the wet filter papers on a semi-dry blotter.
Place the treated membrane on top of buffered filter papers.
Place the gel on top of the membrane.
Wet two thick filter papers in transfer buffer and place them on top of the gel.
Run at 16-20 V (200 mAmp) for approximately 30 min. Do not exceed 25 V.
Rinse membrane in water (2X).
Incubate with 5% MLK/0.05% Tween 20/PBS without Mg/Ca++ at room temperature for 1 hour.
Incubate with primary Ab in MTB (0.1-1 μg per ml) at 4 °C overnight.
Rinse membrane in water (2X).
Incubate with anti-rabbit or anti-mouse HRP (1:10,000-25,000 dilution) at room temperature for 1 hour.
Rinse with PBS+0.05% Tween 20 twice and wash for 10 min at room temperature (3 times).
Remove detection reagents and allow to equilibrate at room temperature before opening.
Mix detection solutions A and solution B in a ratio of 40:1 (Total volume 0.1 ml/cm²).
Pipette detection solution onto the membrane.
Incubate the membrane for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Place the membrane on Saran Wrap.
Autoradiograph the sample.
